Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a compact acceptance checklist designed to speed the pilot to production. The goal here is to make the handoff to CS as smooth as possible and to lock in owner-level acceptance gates.

- Pilot kickoff & environment access: Jun 7 — Northpass approves and provides service account/access
- Data ingestion & sample verification: Jun 14 — Redwood to validate embedding quality and latency targets
- Pilot evaluation window (2 weeks): Jun 21 - Jul 5 — Northpass to exercise pilot scenarios
- Acceptance gate review & sign-off: Jul 8 — Joint review of acceptance checklist; legal to confirm SOW

Please review the attached MAP (Northpass_MAP_v1.xlsx) for owner assignments and the acceptance criteria column. Two asks for you: 1) confirm the list of internal owners (we've tentatively set a Northpass PM as "Elena" in the doc), and 2) flag any hard constraints on the timeline (legal review, procurement blackout dates, security scans).

I'll set up a 30-min working session next week to walk the MAP with your team.
